fields.Name: IT19 - Remote Operations AI Authoring (RO-4)
fields.Description: LIVE-MODEL tier (gated by RUN_AGENT_TESTS — the code is model-authored, costs tokens). Proves the whole RO-4 AI-from-Description authoring loop: RO4-1 saving a GenerationType='AI' Remote Operation invokes the authoring prompt to write the InternalExecute body, stores Code/CodeComments + declared libraries, and sets CodeApprovalStatus='Pending'. RO4-2 approving + saving does NOT regenerate (Description unchanged). RO4-3 the RO-2 emitter produces a complete @RegisterClass'd class with the authored body in InternalExecute. Deterministic structure (creates + deletes its own op); asserts on shape, not exact model text. Skips-as-pass when RUN_AGENT_TESTS is unset.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: An AI op authors a Pending body on save, doesn't regenerate on approve, and emits a complete registered class.
